findings.title: Ignore isolated text when determining paragraph direction
findings.message: Paragraph-direction detection counts strong characters inside bidi isolates, although Unicode's paragraph-direction rules exclude them. For example, "\u2067אבג\u2069abc" is an LTR paragraph, but this function returns RTL. Since cursorVisual uses this result for cross-line movement, horizontal arrows can traverse wrapped lines in the wrong direction.
findings.suggestion: Ignore characters within LRI/RLI/FSI isolates until their matching PDI when finding the first strong character. Add a wrapped-paragraph navigation test with an isolated RTL prefix followed by LTR text.
